summary: R220 makes the F21 shader activation-readiness boundary explicit in sampled DX11 identity and the final ExactSamples predicate. The currently supported fixed-function shader path must be proven separately from shaderTranslationExact, so a future programmable-shader implementation cannot silently inherit exactness. NativeDrawPath remains dormant.
